name: Sihui Fuji Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sihui Fuji Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printed circuit boards in China. The company offers complex, high multi-layer, HDI, heavy copper, metal core, high frequency, high density, thin, long, rigid flex, flex, and rigid printed circuit boards. It also provides printed circuit board assembly for industrial power, vehicle motor, vehicle electronic screen, and solar photovoltaic panels. The company serves industrial control, automotive electronics, communication equipment, medical devices, IC testing and optical module, and AI server fields. The company exports its products.
